from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QPushButton, QLabel, QLineEdit

class TimerApp(QWidget):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title = 'Timer App'
        self.initUI()

    def initUI(self):
        self.setWindowTitle(self.title)

        # Layout setup
        layout = QVBoxLayout()
        
        # Label to show the time
        self.time_label = QLabel('00:00', self)
        layout.addWidget(self.time_label)

        # LineEdit for inputting time in seconds
        self.input_line_edit = QLineEdit(self)
        self.input_line_edit.setPlaceholderText('Enter time in seconds')
        layout.addWidget(self.input_line_edit)

        # Button to start the timer
        self.start_button = QPushButton('Start Timer', self)
        self.start_button.clicked.connect(self.start_timer)
        layout.addWidget(self.start_button)

        # Button to stop the timer
        self.stop_button = QPushButton('Stop Timer', self)
        self.stop_button.clicked.connect(self.stop_timer)
        layout.addWidget(self.stop_button)

        self.setLayout(layout)

        self.setGeometry(300, 300, 300, 150)
        self.show()

    def start_timer(self):
        try:
            seconds = int(self.input_line_edit.text())
            if seconds > 0:
                self.countdown = QTimer()
                self.countdown.timeout.connect(self.update_time)
                self.countdown.start(1000)  # Timer ticks every second
                self.seconds_left = seconds
                self.time_label.setText(self.format_time(seconds))
        except ValueError:
            print("Please enter a valid number")

    def stop_timer(self):
        if hasattr(self, 'countdown'):
            self.countdown.stop()
            self.input_line_edit.clear()
            self.time_label.setText('00:00')

    def update_time(self):
        if self.seconds_left > 0:
            self.seconds_left -= 1
            self.time_label.setText(self.format_time(self.seconds_left))
        else:
            self.stop_timer()

    def format_time(self, seconds):
        minutes = seconds // 60
        secs = seconds % 60
        return f"{minutes:02d}:{secs:02d}"

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app = QApplication([])
    ex = TimerApp()
    sys.exit(app.exec())
